name: Exp_XBullsBearsEyes_Vol
summary: This EA trades based on the XBullsBearsEyes_Vol custom indicator, which combines Bulls Power and Bears Power indicators with volume weighting to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when bullish momentum with volume surges is detected and sell positions when bearish momentum with volume surges is detected, using the indicator's signal changes as entry triggers.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XBullsBearsEyes_Vol自定义指标进行交易，该指标将牛力指标和熊力指标与成交量加权结合，用于检测动量转变。当检测到伴随成交量放大的看涨动量时开多仓，当检测到伴随成交量放大的看跌动量时开空仓，以指标信号变化作为入场触发条件。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Bulls Power和Bears Power两个动量指标的成交量加权版本，通过检测多空力量的变化来判断市场方向。入场条件为当XBullsBearsEyes_Vol指标从看跌信号转为看涨信号时做多，从看涨信号转为看跌信号时做空，本质上是动量反转策略。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，即持有多仓时出现看跌信号则平仓，持有空仓时出现看涨信号则平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过MoneyManagement模块可选择固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数设置，但止损止盈的合理性与否取决于用户参数配置，EA本身缺乏自适应止损机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on a volume-weighted version of the Bulls Power and Bears Power momentum indicators, detecting market direction through changes in bullish and bearish force. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the XBullsBearsEyes_Vol indicator switches from a bearish signal to a bullish signal, and a sell when it switches from bullish to bearish, making it fundamentally a momentum reversal strategy. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals to close positions — long positions close on bearish signals and short positions close on bullish signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with a MoneyManagement module that offers either fixed lots or balance-proportional lot sizing. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameter settings, but the effectiveness depends on user configuration as the EA lacks an adaptive stop loss mechanism.

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 资金管理手数设置，若>=1则为固定手数，若<1则为账户余额比例
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing: >=1 fixed lots, <1 fraction of balance

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不使用追踪止损
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: 结合成交量与动量指标，信号比单纯动量指标更可靠
策略逻辑清晰简洁，信号反转即入场出场，易于理解和验证
提供资金管理模块，支持固定手数和比例手数两种模式
pros_en: Combines volume with momentum indicators, producing more reliable signals than pure momentum alone
Clear and concise strategy logic — signal reversals directly drive entries and exits, making it easy to understand and verify
Includes a money management module supporting both fixed lots and proportional lot sizing
cons: 止损止盈默认为0，若无用户手动配置则交易完全无保护
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内多次开仓造成过度交易
牛力熊力指标在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号，缺乏过滤机制
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, leaving trades completely unprotected if users don't manually configure them
Lacks a new bar check mechanism, potentially causing over-trading by opening multiple positions within the same bar
Bulls/Bears Power indicators tend to produce false signals in ranging markets, and there is no filtering mechanism to address this
improvements: 增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在低趋势强度时减少或避免交易
添加新K线检查和时间间隔控制，防止同一K线重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a ranging market filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to reduce or avoid trading when trend strength is low
Add a new bar check and time interval control to prevent repeated position opening on the same bar

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，未配置时交易无任何价格保护
缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓导致仓位叠加
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit values are 0, meaning trades have no price protection when unconfigured
No new bar check exists, potentially causing position stacking from repeated entries within the same bar

summary_en: This EA trades based on the XBullsBearsEyes_Vol custom indicator, which combines Bulls Power and Bears Power indicators with volume weighting to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when bullish momentum with volume surges is detected and sell positions when bearish momentum with volume surges is detected, using the indicator's signal changes as entry triggers.
